title: CJP Jantar Mantar sit-in day 5: Dipke appears before MeitY panel over blocking of X account
description: CJP’s Abhijeet Dipke questioned why similar confidentiality was not maintained in the NEET paper leak case. “Everything is confidential; you should have kept the NEET paper confidential as well. Why did that leak? These suicides would not have happened,” he said
